newsitem.title: USA: IBM Credit Corp Q3 net rises 34 percent.
newsitem.headline: IBM Credit Corp Q3 net rises 34 percent.

text.p: IBM Credit Corp, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, said Monday third-quarter net earnings rose 34 percent, to $71.6 million from $53.5 million for the same 1995 period.
Capital equipment financing originated for end users in the third quarter of 1996 rose 18 percent to $1,189.9 million from $1,005.2 million in the third quarter of 1995.
Working capital financing originated for distribution channels grew by 42 percent to $3,602.4 million from $2,529.4 million.
The return on average equity in the thrid quarter was 22.9 percent, compared with 21.7 percent in the third quarter of 1995.
For the first nine months of 1996, net earnings rose 25 percent to $219.6 million from $175.4 million.

Capital equipment financing originated for end users rose 17 percent to $3,691.1 million from $3,156.6 million. Working capital financing originated for distribution channels grew by 31 percent to $9,290.0 million from $7,090.2 million, the company said.
